annotations.title: AST-Level Read-Only SQL Query & Injection Safety Validator

description: Performs static AST syntax tree parsing on SQL statements to verify strictly read-only SELECT clauses and reject mutations, stacked queries, or comment bypasses. Use when verifying that an agent-authored SQL statement is strictly read-only before running it on a database; for screening non-SQL bash commands or general agent prompts, use verify_agent_command_safety instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'sql_statement' ('dialect' defaults to 'postgres'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (75 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

dialect.description: SQL dialect ruleset used for AST token inspection; defaults to 'postgres' when omitted.

sql_statement.description: SQL statement string to statically parse and audit for read-only SELECT compliance (e.g. 'SELECT id, email FROM users WHERE active = 1').

name: validate_sql_query_ast

blocked_clauses.description: List of destructive or injection SQL tokens detected.

safe_read_only.description: True when the query is a pure SELECT statement with zero injection clauses.

tables_accessed.description: Table identifiers referenced in FROM and JOIN clauses.
